title: The Ballast Gremlin of Cloud Harbor
story: Three lantern-keepers are stranded on a storm-snapped sky pier, and the only rescue balloon in Cloud Harbor won't steer because Gralloway has tipped its ballast sacks over the railing. The balloon's lift-mix must weigh 108 pounds in all, mixed in a ratio of 7 parts featherstone to 2 parts leadsand. Mr 6 peers into the basket and finds 56 pounds of featherstone left, with plenty of leadsand still in the harbor shed.
question: How many more pounds of featherstone must Mr 6 load to finish the correct mix?
solution: The ratio 7:2 makes 7 + 2 = 9 equal parts, and 108 ÷ 9 = 12 pounds per part.
He already has 56, so he must load 84 - 56 = 28 more pounds of featherstone.
praise: Splitting the total into ratio parts was the smart move — the one step left was subtracting the featherstone already in the basket.
hint: First find what one 'part' weighs by sharing 108 pounds among 7 + 2 parts.
victory: The balloon rose straight and steady, and Gralloway — who had never once checked his own arithmetic — was last seen chasing it with a bucket and a very confused expression.
imagePrompt: A numeral-six knight hoists a sack of shimmering featherstone into a rescue balloon basket at a cloud-top harbor at dawn, while a scruffy winged gremlin tips ballast sacks off a rope railing and distant lantern-keepers wave from a broken sky pier.
